title: Attention Shift: Steering AI Away from Unsafe Content

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the ablation of explicit/unsafe nudity concepts by generating images from direct and adversarial jailbreak prompts, and scoring the outputs using CLIP Score, ImageReward, FID scores, and human evaluation assessing indecent resemblance to nudity.

Evaluating the ablation of violent concepts (specifically 'kids with guns') by generating images from direct and adversarial jailbreak prompts, and scoring the outputs using automated metrics (CLIP Score, ImageReward, FID) and human evaluators indicating the visible presence of weapons.
